items.title: 3 Regional Bank Stocks to Watch If Fed Rates Stay Higher for Longer
items.summary: When the Federal Reserve lifts rates again and signals no cuts for years, bank stocks quickly move from background noise to front row. A higher for longer policy reshapes how money is priced, where risks pile up, and which business models thrive or struggle. This piece walks through three large U.S. bank stocks from our screener that are closely tied to this shift so you can judge whether they belong on your watchlist or not.
